name: Potoybichchya
source:
I woke up to the light from the window and a headache, not even remembering my name...Will I be able to remember everything?

[Translated from [url=https://s-chaem.itch.io/potoybicha]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
我被窗外的灯光吵醒，头疼得连自己的名字都不记得了……我能记住一切吗？

[译自[url=https://s-chaem.itch.io/potoybicha]itch.io[/url]]
